newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - West Haven, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - West Haven, Conn..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the City of West Haven, Connecticut, at Robinson & Cole, Conference Room 26B, 26th Floor, One Commercial Plaza, Hartford, Connecticut, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated November 20, 1996.
Maturities: $350,000 on October 15 in each of the years
each of the years 2003-2010, both inclusive,
and $500,000 on October 15 in each of the
Interest Paid: April 15,1997 and semiannually thereafter on
October 15 and April 15 in each year

The Bonds shall be designated by the City as qualified tax exempt obligations under the provisions of Section 265(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, for purposes of the deduction by financial institutions for interest expense allocable to the Bonds. For copies of the official Notice of Sale, the Official Statement of the City of West Haven, Connecticut, dated November 20, 1996, and bid form, please contact Mr. Michael McKinnon, Independent Bond and Investment Consultants, 27 Parker Avenue, Madison, Connecticut 06443 (203-245-8715).
